name: Atanas Kirjakovski

evidence: Anchor = rare surname + organization + research field + Japan link. LinkedIn snippet: 'Atanas Kirjakovski - International Balkan University'; ResearchGate snippet: 'Atanas KIRJAKOVSKI | Associate Professor | International Balkan University, Skopje | IBU | Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences', matching his Google Scholar profile. He is a cognitive psychologist (PhD Kobe University, JSPS postdoc at Kobe), which fits the paper's venue (Journal of Cultural Cognitive Science) and its cross-linguistic colour-term topic, and fits the Japan-based group around D. M. Marutschke. Surname Kirjakovski is rare; no competing namesake appeared. Email: NOT found - the only lead was a ZoomInfo page showing a masked address '****@ibu.edu.mk'; an exact-phrase search for 'kirjakovski@ibu.edu.mk' returned only that masked ZoomInfo listing and unrelated IBU pages, so nothing is actually printed anywhere. Constructing it from the ibu.edu.mk pattern would be a templated guess, which is forbidden. The Springer article page (link.springer.com) and the IBU journal site are blocked by the network egress proxy, so no printed address could be checked there. ROUND 2: found a REAL PRINTED address. frontiersin.org, ibu.edu.mk, beta.ibu.edu.mk, ijep.ibupress.com, loop.frontiersin.org, core.ac.uk, semanticscholar.org, scholar.archive.org, api.openalex.org and doi.org are all blocked by the egress proxy, so no page could be fetched directly; the address was recovered from search results instead. A search for the IBU staff page and for 'corresponding author' surfaced his sole-authored Frontiers in Cognition conceptual-analysis paper 'Rethinking perception and cognition in the digital environment' (DOI 10.3389/fcogn.2023.1266404, received 24 Jul 2023, accepted 31 Oct 2023, published 01 Dec 2023). Two separate searches returned the article's own front-matter, including the verbatim Frontiers correspondence block '*CORRESPONDENCE Atanas Kirjakovski kirjakovski@ibu.edu.mk'. This is a printed correspondence address in a published paper by exactly this person (sole author, International Balkan University, Skopje, cognitive psychology), not a mask and not a construction - the earlier ZoomInfo '****@ibu.edu.mk' mask remains unusable and was not relied on, and an exact-phrase search for the address still returns only that mask, so the journal article is the source of record.
